384:   private static Grid createSubBoxes(
385:       double shapeMinLat,
386:       double shapeMaxLat,
387:       double shapeMinLon,
388:       double shapeMaxLon,
389:       Function<Rectangle, Relation> boxToRelation) {
390:     final int minLat = encodeLatitudeCeil(shapeMinLat);
391:     final int maxLat = encodeLatitude(shapeMaxLat);
392:     final int minLon = encodeLongitudeCeil(shapeMinLon);
393:     final int maxLon = encodeLongitude(shapeMaxLon);
394: 
395:     if (maxLat < minLat || (shapeMaxLon >= shapeMinLon && maxLon < minLon)) {
396:       // the box cannot match any quantized point
397:       return new Grid(1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, new byte[0]);
398:     }
399: 
400:     final int latShift, lonShift;
401:     final int latBase, lonBase;
402:     final int maxLatDelta, maxLonDelta;
403:     {
404:       long minLat2 = (long) minLat - Integer.MIN_VALUE;
405:       long maxLat2 = (long) maxLat - Integer.MIN_VALUE;
406:       latShift = computeShift(minLat2, maxLat2);
407:       latBase = (int) (minLat2 >>> latShift);
408:       maxLatDelta = (int) (maxLat2 >>> latShift) - latBase + 1;
409:       assert maxLatDelta > 0;
410:     }
411:     {
412:       long minLon2 = (long) minLon - Integer.MIN_VALUE;
413:       long maxLon2 = (long) maxLon - Integer.MIN_VALUE;
414:       if (shapeMaxLon < shapeMinLon) { // crosses dateline
415:         maxLon2 += 1L << 32; // wrap
416:       }
417:       lonShift = computeShift(minLon2, maxLon2);
418:       lonBase = (int) (minLon2 >>> lonShift);
419:       maxLonDelta = (int) (maxLon2 >>> lonShift) - lonBase + 1;
420:       assert maxLonDelta > 0;
421:     }
422: 
423:     final byte[] relations = new byte[maxLatDelta * maxLonDelta];
424:     for (int i = 0; i < maxLatDelta; ++i) {
425:       for (int j = 0; j < maxLonDelta; ++j) {
426:         final int boxMinLat = ((latBase + i) << latShift) + Integer.MIN_VALUE;
427:         final int boxMinLon = ((lonBase + j) << lonShift) + Integer.MIN_VALUE;
428:         final int boxMaxLat = boxMinLat + (1 << latShift) - 1;
429:         final int boxMaxLon = boxMinLon + (1 << lonShift) - 1;
430: 
431:         relations[i * maxLonDelta + j] =
432:             (byte)
433:                 boxToRelation
434:                     .apply(
435:                         new Rectangle(
436:                             decodeLatitude(boxMinLat), decodeLatitude(boxMaxLat),
437:                             decodeLongitude(boxMinLon), decodeLongitude(boxMaxLon)))
438:                     .ordinal();
439:       }
440:     }
441: 
442:     return new Grid(latShift, lonShift, latBase, lonBase, maxLatDelta, maxLonDelta, relations);
443:   }

445:   /**
446:    * Compute the minimum shift value so that {@code (b>>>shift)-(a>>>shift)} is less that {@code
447:    * ARITY}.
448:    */
449:   private static int computeShift(long a, long b) {
450:     assert a <= b;
451:     // We enforce a shift of at least 1 so that when we work with unsigned ints
452:     // by doing (lat - MIN_VALUE), the result of the shift (lat - MIN_VALUE) >>> shift
453:     // can be used for comparisons without particular care: the sign bit has
454:     // been cleared so comparisons work the same for signed and unsigned ints
455:     for (int shift = 1; ; ++shift) {
456:       final long delta = (b >>> shift) - (a >>> shift);
457:       if (delta >= 0 && delta < Grid.ARITY) {
458:         return shift;
459:       }
460:     }
461:   }

520:      * directly on the encoded representation of points.

522:     public boolean test(int lat, int lon) {
523:       final int lat2 = ((lat - Integer.MIN_VALUE) >>> latShift);
524:       if (lat2 < latBase || lat2 >= latBase + maxLatDelta) {
525:         return false;
526:       }
527:       int lon2 = ((lon - Integer.MIN_VALUE) >>> lonShift);
528:       if (lon2 < lonBase) { // wrap
529:         lon2 += 1 << (32 - lonShift);
530:       }

532:       assert lon2 - lonBase >= 0;

537:       final int relation = relations[(lat2 - latBase) * maxLonDelta + (lon2 - lonBase)];
538:       if (relation == Relation.CELL_CROSSES_QUERY.ordinal()) {
539:         return SloppyMath.haversinSortKey(

541:             <= distanceKey;
542:       } else {
543:         return relation == Relation.CELL_INSIDE_QUERY.ordinal();

part.text:
Done. The issue was an integer overflow in the quantized-grid component predicate in `lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/geo/GeoEncodingUtils.java`:

**Root cause:** In `Component2DPredicate.test` (and `DistancePredicate.test`), the latitude range check `lat2 >= latBase + maxLatDelta` overflows when the grid reaches the top of the encoded latitude range: for a polygon touching the north pole, `latBase + maxLatDelta = 2147483646 + 2` wraps to `-2147483648`, so valid points near latitude 90 were wrongly rejected before even consulting the polygon.

**Fix:** Compute the check in overflow-safe form, `lat2 - latBase >= maxLatDelta` (matching the existing longitude check), in both `DistancePredicate.test` (GeoEncodingUtils.java:523) and `Component2DPredicate.test` (GeoEncodingUtils.java:571).

**Verification:**
- Reproduced the bug standalone (`predicate.test=false` before, `true` after), with sanity checks that outside points are still rejected.
- `TestLatLonPointQueries.testNarrowPolygonCloseToNorthPole` and `TestLatLonDocValuesQueries.testNarrowPolygonCloseToNorthPole` now pass.
- Full geo suites pass with no failures: `TestLatLonPointQueries` (43 tests), `TestLatLonDocValuesQueries` (42), `org.apache.lucene.geo.*`, `TestLatLonPoint`, `TestLatLonDocValuesField`, `TestLatLonLineShapeQueries`.
